title: Preventing token claims until vesting period ends
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `g8keepVester` contract, responsible for managing token vesting schedules, contains an error in its implementation that prevents users from claiming any tokens until the entire vesting period has elapsed.
